title: Predictive values and likelihood ratios
summary: PPV and NPV with Wilson intervals, likelihood ratios with log-scale intervals, and the PPV recomputed at another prevalence.
pinned_defaults: PPV and NPV as single proportions with Wilson score intervals (prop.test without continuity correction; statsmodels method = 'wilson').
Likelihood ratios with log-scale intervals (Simel, Samsa and Matchar 1991).
PPV at prevalence 0.05 by Bayes' rule from the estimated sensitivity and specificity.
_prevalence: Predictive values belong to the population sampled: 0.68 at this cohort's 20% prevalence, 0.30 at 5%. A case-control sample gives no valid predictive values.
